hook: Line up sound jars on the tray, slide them through the oven to hear the blend, and read the word on the box.
outcome: Blend, segment, and decode digraphs, consonant blends, final-e, vowel teams, two-syllable words, endings, and irregular words
sources: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts, Reading: Foundational Skills, Grade 1 (RF.1.2a-d, RF.1.3a-g)
Merriam-Webster Dictionary: Spelling rules (doubling final consonants, dropping silent e) and homophones (feet/feat, seat)
Reading Rockets: Spelling and adding suffixes (-s, -ed, -ing)
Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
